intent: Controlled-state variants for the sixteen remaining Batch 005 neutral dwellings; preserve every exact base identity while making active muster readiness legible on the overworld.
shared_prompt_constraints: Preserve exact base architecture, perspective, proportions, palette, silhouette, and painterly strategy-map rendering.
Add only restrained active-muster cues: open access, ordered equipment and supplies, working light, and teal-and-ivory claim cloth.
No people, creatures, words, labels, UI, background, ground plane, border, copied franchise elements, or protected visual expression.
Retain genuine transparent alpha outside the object and generous transparent margins.
alpha_recovery: Fifteen precise edits returned pale generated backdrops and were background-keyed with edge cleanup before atlas reduction. Tidepool Skiffyard failed that review and received one targeted built-in background-extraction pass. All accepted sources and the runtime atlas have genuine alpha and transparent corners.
